answer_1.quote: In recent times, a variety of neural text-to-speech (TTS) systems have been developed . Initially, these systems generate intermediate representations, such as mel spectrograms or hidden representations, conditioned on textual input. This is followed by the use of a neural vocoder for the synthesis of the raw audio waveform.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated our algorithm using the Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ) and a deep learning evaluation approach, DNSMos .

answer_4.quote: Additionally, we conduct a subjective audio evaluation using a 5-point Mean Opinion Score (MOS) test, involving 30 examples per model and 20 participants.
